messages:
Marco (FinOps): Heads up — GCP invoice 2026-03 shows ~$42,000 of night-surge credits moved into project 'platform-sandbox' instead of team projects. Not sure when that started. billing-bot: Automated alert: Unusual project reallocation detected for billing account: BA-12345, window: 2026-03-09 00:00-06:00 UTC. Anya (Billing Ops): Ugh. Can someone paste the invoice link and the raw cost export? I want to check ledger ids. Devon (Infra): Linking the export I pulled: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports/BA-12345?folder=nightly-slices — csv contains rows where label 'gpu_owner' is empty and fallback set to 'platform-sandbox'. Anya (Billing Ops): thanks — can you drop the sample rows? Samir (ML Platform): early theory: last week's pricing experiment added a fallback label for preemptible routing (label=preempt_fallback=platform-sandbox) so when K8s pod labels weren't propagated the cost mapping rule matched that fallback. Teri (CostOps): That would explain sudden credit assignment to platform account instead of team buckets. Any evidence in allocation rules? Devon (Infra): Here's the SQL I ran against cost_export.bigquery to surface suspect rows:
```
SELECT invoice_month, project_id, label_gpu_owner, label_preempt_fallback, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_costs`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03'
  AND usage_start_time >= '2026-03-09'
  AND (label_gpu_owner IS NULL OR label_gpu_owner = '')
  AND label_preempt_fallback IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY invoice_month, project_id, label_gpu_owner, label_preempt_fallback
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Devon (Infra): results show project_id=platform-sandbox, label_preempt_fallback=platform-sandbox, cost=42134.78 across many entries. Anya (Billing Ops): Ok — two prongs: 1) retro-map those orphan rows to team owners and issue credit or internal reallocation, 2) stop the routing rule that sets fallback label to platform-sandbox for unmatched pods. Marco (FinOps): Agreed. What's the impact to budgets? Teri (CostOps): A few mid-market customers' committed credits dipped vs expected; if we don't reallocate, finance will flag revenue impact in next week. I recommend a temporary manual reallocation and a follow-up automation ticket. Samir (ML Platform): I'll open PR to change fallback to 'unallocated' and add a webhook that rejects label-less allocations. Devon (Infra): I'll produce a mapping file of affected ledger_ids and propose journal entries. Anya (Billing Ops): For the manual reallocation, I need: (a) list of ledger_id, original project label candidate (best guess), and cost; (b) approval from finance. Marco (FinOps): Approve the reallocation up to $45k if you can get the mapping and a short QA. Anya (Billing Ops): copying our template for internal credit memo — fill this, I'll run it through accounting:
```
- invoice_ref: 2026-03-09-BA-12345
- affected_cost_lines: [ledger_ids...]
- original_owner_candidate: team_name
- amount: numeric
- justification: fallback label mismatch after pricing-experiment
```
Devon (Infra): dropping sample mapping in GDrive: https://drive.redwood.internal/finance/nightly-credit-maps/3105678901.csv Samir (ML Platform): PR: https://git.redwood/repo/ml-platform/patches/PR-783 — changes fallback label + safeguards. Teri (CostOps): Also request we add a nightly alert when >$5k migrates to 'platform-sandbox' to catch regression. billing-bot: Action logged: ticket BILL-4521 created and assigned to Anya, Devon, Samir, Teri; severity: P2. Anya (Billing Ops): I'll run the reallocation script once mapping validated and post final journal IDs. Anyone opposed to internal reclassification? Marco (FinOps): no objections. Samir (ML Platform): one more ask — please include the timestamps of pods/assignments so we can tie to autoscaler events. Devon (Infra): will include. Anya (Billing Ops): I'll post the completed memo + journal IDs here when done. Teri (CostOps): follow-up: we should add a unit test to the pricing experiment harness so fallback label has to be explicitly approved. Samir (ML Platform): yep, will add. Marco (FinOps): thanks all. Closing notes: reallocation approved, automation ticket opened, alert threshold set. :thumbsup:
